name: The Avengers
headquarters: Avengers Tower / Avengers Compound (Upstate New York)
description: Earth's Mightiest Heroes brought together under S.H.I.E.L.D.'s Avengers Initiative to fight battles that humanity never could. Founding roster: Iron Man, Captain America, Thor, Hulk, Black Widow, and Hawkeye.

name: Guardians of the Galaxy
description: An eccentric intergalactic crew of outlaws, mercenaries, and assassins who banded together in the Kyln prison to defend the cosmos against Ronan the Accuser and Thanos.

name: The X-Men
headquarters: Xavier's School for Gifted Youngsters (Westchester County, New York)
description: A team of mutant heroes assembled by Charles Xavier dedicated to peaceful coexistence between mutants and humans while opposing hostile threats to both species.

name: Brotherhood of Mutants
headquarters: Liberty Island / The Savage Land / Genosha
description: Radical mutant militant faction formed by Magneto, believing that mutants are Homo superior and that war with humanity is both inevitable and necessary for survival.

name: Fantastic Four
description: Four astronauts genetically altered by cosmic radiation on a private space station who became celebrated public heroes: Mister Fantastic, Invisible Woman, Human Torch, and The Thing.

name: The Illuminati
firstFilmAppearance: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness (2022)
description: A covert clandestine council of premier heroes assembled on Earth-838 to make paramount moral and multiversal decisions and prevent incursions.

name: Spider-Society
description: A coalition of hundreds of Spider-heroes across the multiverse founded by Miguel O'Hara to monitor the Web of Life and Destiny, eliminate anomalies, and protect canon events.

name: X-Force
headquarters: Sister Margaret's School for Wayward Girls (New York)
description: A makeshift mutant strike squad recruited by Deadpool to intercept Cable and protect Russell Collins, famous for its calamitous initial parachute drop.

name: S.H.I.E.L.D.
description: Strategic Homeland Intervention, Enforcement and Logistics Division — global security agency monitoring enhanced individuals and alien threats, founded by Peggy Carter and Howard Stark.

name: HYDRA
leader: Red Skull / Alexander Pierce / Baron von Strucker
description: Authoritarian subversive organization dedicated to global dominance. Originating in WWII under Johann Schmidt, HYDRA secretly infiltrated S.H.I.E.L.D. for over six decades.

name: Dora Milaje
description: The elite, all-female royal guard and special forces unit of the Kingdom of Wakanda, sworn to protect the Golden Tribe and defend Wakanda with vibranium spears.

name: The Ravagers
description: An interstellar confederation of space pirates, thieves, and smugglers bound by an honor code forbidding trafficking in children, divided into distinct clans.

name: Time Variance Authority (TVA)
leader: He Who Remains / Judge Ravonna Renslayer / B-15
description: A bureaucratic multiversal entity operating outside time and space, originally tasked with pruning branched timelines to maintain the Sacred Timeline.

name: Thunderbolts* / New Avengers
leader: Contessa Valentina Allegra de Fontaine / Bucky Barnes
description: A covert ops unit of reformed anti-heroes and assassins assembled by Valentina Allegra de Fontaine, including Yelena Belova, Bucky Barnes, U.S. Agent, Ghost, and Red Guardian.

name: The Eternals
description: An immortal synthetic race of ancient cosmic beings dispatched to Earth by the Celestial Arishem in 5000 BC to eliminate Deviants and incubate the planet.
